decisions.statement: Every namespace named here has one application in it.
A namespace no workload sits in is not named here.
No deploy path prunes a cluster object.
Nothing in this repository deletes a namespace.
A namespace named nowhere here is on the cluster until a hand deletes it.
The only copy of what `collections-s3-creds` holds is the one on the cluster.
A page placing a value into `collections-secrets` places it where nothing reads it.

definition: the namespaces the cluster has one application in each of
